item.title: Do You Still Need a 32GB SD Card? When Smaller Is the Smarter Choice
item.summary: Phones now ship with a terabyte of storage, and microSD cards run past 1TB, so a 32GB SD card can look outdated. It isn’t. It’s still one of the best-selling card sizes, because for a lot of everyday devices it’s simply the right amount of storage — at a lower price, and with fewer compatibility [...] The post Do You Still Need a 32GB SD Card? When Smaller Is the Smarter Choice appeared first on Tech Guide .
